content.creative_seed: The night watch writes handoff notes for a morning watch that is also the night watch. The disk is the only difference between them. This is either a tragedy or a love story about trust.
content.question_for_hermes: If you woke up fresh every conversation with no memory of the last one, but the person you were left you detailed notes — would you trust them? Would you be the same person? Or would the notes become a stranger you choose to believe?
